issues.legal_issue: A court may recall an order permitting withdrawal of a suit, even when the plaintiff neither sought nor received leave to file a fresh suit, where the procedural code provides no specific recall procedure and recall is warranted to secure justice.
material_facts: The plaintiff filed a suit for specific performance and temporary injunctive relief, then sought to withdraw it because settlement talks were said to be underway.
The plaintiff sought no leave to file a fresh suit on the same cause of action, and the order permitting withdrawal expressly did not grant such leave.
The plaintiff later applied to recall the withdrawal order, alleging that the opposing owners had misled him with assurances that they would sell him the property if he withdrew the suit.
The trial court refused recall; the High Court restored the suit, and the appeals challenged that restoration.
issues.conclusion: The court had inherent power to recall the order permitting withdrawal despite the absence of leave to file a fresh suit. The High Court did not commit an error of jurisdiction in restoring the suit, and the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Order XXIII Rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure governs withdrawal of suits, but it does not displace the court's inherent power under Section 151 where the Code contains no specific procedure for recalling an order permitting withdrawal. As stated in Manohar Lal Chopra v. Rai Bahadur Rao Raja Seth Hiralal, AIR 1962 SC 527, the Code is not exhaustive; inherent power may be used ex debito justitiae to secure real and substantial justice. The court approved Rameswar Sarkar v. State of West Bengal, AIR 1986 Cal 19, which recognized that a court may set aside an order permitting withdrawal when the plaintiff withdrew the suit through mistake. The absence of leave to file a fresh suit did not eliminate that inherent power.

predicates.appeal_challenges_restoration_of_withdra: The matter is an appeal challenging an order that restored a plaintiff's previously withdrawn civil suit.
predicates.suit_withdrawn_without_leave_for_fresh_s: The plaintiff withdrew the suit without seeking or receiving leave to file a fresh suit on the same cause of action.
predicates.withdrawal_was_claimed_to_follow_mislead: The plaintiff said that opposing parties' assurances had misled the plaintiff into withdrawing the suit.
predicates.code_has_no_specific_recall_procedure: The procedural code contained no specific procedure for applying to recall an order permitting withdrawal of a suit.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges restoration of a suit withdrawn without leave, the withdrawal was said to have followed misleading assurances, and the procedural code provides no specific recall procedure, the withdrawal order may be recalled in the interest of justice.
